# Coto Academy

> > Coto Academy is a Japanese language school in Tokyo offering JLPT courses, grammar lessons, cultural activities, and career support for students learning Japanese in Japan.

Based in Iidabashi and Kagurazaka, Tokyo, Coto Academy provides comprehensive Japanese language education from beginner to advanced levels, with specialized JLPT preparation courses (particularly N3), cultural immersion events, and career transition services through Coto Work for students seeking employment in Japan.

## Key Topics

- JLPT N3 preparation and grammar
- Japanese language learning strategies
- Life in Japan for foreign residents
- Japanese culture and traditions
- Verb conjugation and grammar points
- Spaced Repetition System (SRS) learning
- Language learning apps (Memrise, MindSnacks)
- Career transitions in Japan
- Tokyo neighborhoods (Kagurazaka, Iidabashi)
- Japanese vocabulary and phrases
- Cultural events and cooking classes
- Student success stories
- Emergency preparedness in Japan

## JLPT Test Preparation & Courses

- [Stay Worry-Free with Coto's JLPT Course in Yokohama!](https://cotoacademy.com/save-big-on-jlpt-course-prep-at-coto-academy-yokohama): JLPT N2/N3 prep courses at Coto Yokohama with early bird discounts
- [Pass the N3 Grammar Section - Self-Study Course](https://cotoacademy.com/pass-jlpt-n3-grammar-online-course): JLPT N3 grammar self-study online course with interactive lessons
- [JLPT N3 Grammar Point: ~ppanashi (っぱなし)](https://cotoacademy.com/jlpt-n3-grammar-point-%E3%81%A3%E3%81%B1%E3%81%AA%E3%81%97): JLPT N3 grammar lesson explaining ~ppanashi usage and conjugation

## Japanese Learning Resources & Tips

- [5 Tips for Learning Japanese](https://cotoacademy.com/top-5-tips-for-learning-japanese): Study strategies for efficient Japanese learning: goals, practice, verbs
- [Top 3 Japanese Flash Card Game Learning Applications in 2018](https://cotoacademy.com/japanese-learning-applications-2018): Reviews top Japanese flashcard apps: Memrise, MindSnacks, Kanji no Owari
- [How to Use the Japanese Word "Hutsuni"](https://cotoacademy.com/use-hutsuni-japanese-aiueo): Colloquial usage guide for Japanese word "hutsuni" (normally) explained
- [Coto Sounds – Japanese learning Podcast Ep 3 – Having lunch with a friend](https://cotoacademy.com/coto-sounds-japanese-learning-podcast-ep-3-having-lunch-with-a-friend): Podcast episode 3: lunch conversation with transcript and restaurant phrases

## Living & Working in Japan

- [Elevate Your IT Career in Japan with Coto Work](https://cotoacademy.com/elevate-your-it-career-in-japan-with-coto-work): Coto Work recruitment services for IT careers and tech jobs in Japan
- [Corina: From no Japanese to working in a Japanese company](https://cotoacademy.com/corina-working-in-a-japanese-company): Student success story: Australian Corina's journey to Japanese employment
- [How to Switch From English Teaching to Recruitment in Japan](https://cotoacademy.com/how-to-make-a-career-switch-from-english-teaching-to-recruitment-in-japan): Career transition guide from English teaching to recruitment jobs in Japan
- [COVID-19 in Japan - Important Japanese Vocabulary & How to Track Cases](https://cotoacademy.com/coronavocab): Essential COVID-19 vocabulary and case tracking resources for Japan
- [What To Do During an Earthquake in Japan: Emergency Kit, Vocabulary & Evacuation](https://cotoacademy.com/what-to-do-during-an-earthquake-in-japan-emergency-kit-vocabulary-evacuation): Earthquake safety guide with emergency kit list and Japanese vocabulary

## Japanese Culture & Seasonal Events

- [Best time to visit Japan: A Year-Round Guide to Seasonal Japan](https://cotoacademy.com/best-time-to-vist-japan-where-to-go-and-what-to-do): Seasonal travel guide: cherry blossoms, festivals across Tokyo and Kyoto
- [A Sparkling Christmas in Japan: Traditions, Treats, and Twinkling Lights](https://cotoacademy.com/a-sparkling-christmas-in-japan-traditions-treats-and-twinkling-lights): Christmas in Japan: illuminations, KFC tradition, Tokyo holiday markets
- [Vernal Equinox Day (春分の日): The Start of Spring](https://cotoacademy.com/vernal-equinox-day): Japanese holiday guide: Vernal Equinox Day traditions and celebrations
- [Pokemon Names in Japanese - Learn How to Say Pokemon in Japanese!](https://cotoacademy.com/pokemon-names-in-japanese-how-to-say): Pokemon names translated to Japanese katakana with pronunciation guide
